title: Final Check · Weeks 9–12
subtitle: 20 marks · no help · 20 minutes

sections.title: A. Complete the sentences (10 marks)
items: 1) If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
2) I'll call you as soon as I ___ (get) home.
3) If you don't hurry, you ___ (miss) the bus.
4) I enjoy ___ (read) before bed.
5) We decided ___ (stay) in a hotel.
6) Do you mind ___ (close) the door?
7) A pilot is a person ___ flies planes.
8) This is the café ___ we first met.
9) I ___ live in Tanta, but now I live in Cairo.
10) ___ broke the window? — Omar did.

sections.title: B. Translate into English (5 marks)
items: 1) إذا كان الهاتف معيبًا، سيستبدلونه.
2) أريد أن أنضم إلى نادٍ للشطرنج.
3) الرجل الذي يسكن بجوارنا مهندس.
4) كنت ألعب كرة القدم في الشارع.
5) ماذا حدث في العمل اليوم؟
answers: 1) If the phone is faulty, they'll (they will) replace it.
2) I want to join a chess club.
3) The man who (that) lives next door is an engineer.
4) I used to play football in the street.

sections.title: C. Write the Arabic meaning (5 marks)
items: 4) worth visiting = __________
5) pocket money = __________

sections.title: D. Speaking check — tick what you can do
items: ☐ I can explain a problem and suggest solutions with if and when.
☐ I can talk about my hobbies and interests.
☐ I can describe people and places with who, which and where.
☐ I can compare my life in the past and now.

score: My score: ______ / 20   18–20 Excellent · 16–17 Very good · under 16: repeat the sentences of these weeks for 3 days, then try again.
